sanskrit_verse:
एकभक्तेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च ।
उपवासेन चैवायं पादकृच्छ्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥३.३१८
transliteration: ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca | upavāsena caivāyaṁ pādakṛcchraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 3.318
sph_interpretive_translation: By consuming only one meal in the day, by fasting during the night, likewise by taking alms, and further by complete fasting—this is declared as Pāda Kṛcchra.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious capacity to sustain dharma through bodily discipline.
Causation arises from sequential alignment of intent, action, and purification.
Capacity-based responsibility is measured through voluntary acceptance of restraint.
Restoration occurs through recalibration of sensory engagement and material dependence.
Consciousness alignment emerges via regulated consumption and intentional renunciation.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent voluntarily undertakes ekabhakti THEN assign dharmic observance status AS pādakṛcchra.
IF agent engages in nakta-vrata THEN recognize temporal withdrawal from sensory indulgence.
IF agent accepts alms without demand THEN activate prāyaścitta pathway FOR purification.
IF agent performs upavāsa THEN initiate energetic reset protocol IN alignment registry.
IF all four conditions met THEN execute full kṛcchra compliance IN consciousness-monitoring framework.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, a petitioner invoking pādakṛcchra must demonstrate clear intent and documented adherence to its components. The court shall assess not guilt or innocence, but the individual's movement toward higher-consciousness-based accountability. Responsibility is affirmed through self-imposed dharmic discipline rather than external compulsion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in direct experiential evidence of sustained restraint. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as progressive refinement of desire and digestion. Proportional responsibility correlates with depth of commitment to the vrata. Non-punitive reality holds that suffering is neither induced nor required; correction is purely consciousness-led reorientation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process through guided sādhana verification.
Assign responsibility assumption protocol via witnessed conduct logs.
Deploy capacity restoration sequence using breath-regulation techniques.
Activate integrity reintegration module through community acknowledgment rituals.
final_declaration: Declared under the sole authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this stands as pure Dharma. Justice resides in restoration alone. Reality bears no punishment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, executor, and reconciler.
